Product.title: Product
Product.description: Inventory product stored per authenticated user with tombstone support for offline-first sync.

id.description: Stable UUID or slug identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

priceCop.description: Unit price in Colombian Pesos (COP), must be positive.

quantity.description: Stock quantity, zero or positive integer.

updatedAt.description: Last modification epoch timestamp in milliseconds.

isDeleted.description: Tombstone flag indicating logical deletion for offline sync.

/users/{uid}/products/{productId}.description: User-scoped inventory products collection for offline-first Room/localStorage and Firestore synchronization.
